objective.text: Learn 10 more, 10 less, 100 more and 100 less. Show them with plus and minus.

explanations.title: Add or remove a disk
explanations.text: Show 157 with disks. Add 1 tens disk to show 10 more. Add 1 hundreds disk to show 100 more.

explanations.title: Say it with a sentence
explanations.text: 10 more than 157 is 167. Also, 167 is 10 more than 157. We can write 157 plus 10 equals 167.

explanations.title: The arrow way
explanations.text: Write the start number. Draw one arrow for each change. Plus 100 changes the hundreds. Minus 10 changes the tens.

explanations.title: Number patterns
explanations.text: Look at 135, 145, 155. Each number is 10 more than the one before. The rule is plus 10.

examples.title: 157 plus 10
examples.text: Start with 157. Add 1 tens disk. Now there are 6 tens. The number is 167. 157 plus 10 equals 167.

examples.title: 157 plus 100
examples.text: Start with 157. Add 1 hundreds disk. Now there are 2 hundreds. The number is 257. 157 plus 100 equals 257.

examples.title: Arrow way from 542
examples.text: Start at 542. Plus 100 is 642. Minus 10 is 632. Minus 10 is 622. Minus 100 is 522. Minus 100 is 422.

questions.text: The numbers are 135, 145, 155, 165, 175. What is the rule?
The numbers are 282, 272, 262, 252, 242. What is the rule?
The rule is minus 10. The numbers are 67, 57, 47. What are the next 3 numbers?
542 plus 100, minus 10, minus 10, minus 100, minus 100. What number do you end on?
A shelter saved 27 kittens in June, 11 in July and 40 in August. How many kittens in all?
The shelter saved 78 kittens. 64 found homes. How many still need homes?
How do you change a number to make it 100 more? Use place value words.
499 is 100 less than a number. Do you add 100 or take away 100? Why?

examples.title: 450 minus 260
